### Open Comment "+" to view the CD Documentation and Changelog History ###
============================================================================ Project: Kawasaki E-Series AS - ARC Welding Created on: 2020/09/17 Created by: MRe ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- Changelog (yyyy/mm/dd - by - Description): 2023/11/24 - CBe - Added init of frame point at the beginning of each touch operation group 2023/10/02 - CBe - Added TouchID_Prev, TouchID_Curr, TouchID_Prev_Used and TouchID_Curr_Used to allow TouchID AFTER Circle start/BEFORE Circle VIA 2023/09/20 - CBe - Added TouchSensing support for 6D / rotating search 2022/07/26 - CBe - Removed Python calls, corrected variable naming, unique rule-based point names, added sub progarm support, fixed online LaserTracking syntax, dynamic base frame 0> DYN_BASE* 2022/06/07 - CBe - integrate wait, signaling and resourceport events 2022/06/06 - CBe - integrate TouchSensingWorkMethod (R2022.1) and replace old ContourPointWorkMethod 2021/12/20 - MGL - integration and code expression for Touch Sensing 2021/04/12 - JFa - integration of the latest E2 events (ARCWELDCONDITION, LT_PARAM, LT_EVENT) 2020/09/18 - MRe - Motion Data output generation based on MotionProfiles (not direct on Events) 2020/09/18 - MRe - Added MotionType 'Point to Point' for ARC output 2020/09/17 - MRe - Initial version ============================================================================ Common Information: ------------------------- # Only Implicit target output supported! -> CENOlpDataOutputStyle has to be set on Controller/Robot! # Motion Data handling by Motion Profies (SPEED/ACCEL/ACCURACY/CP) -> PTP Speed always in %, PATH Speed always in mm/s ; # Flags (Integer 0|1 or Boolean false|true) IS_SYNC_MOVE == Flag to switch the synchron output mode - TRSUB(Position) Dependent on BASEFRAME Names in E2 ('COP_CURRENT_PROFILE_BASE_NAME'). True, if name starts with "DYN_BASE" ; ARC_OUTPUT == Flag to activate the ArcCommand output 0 == no output (for verification in Emulator; no W1SET / W2SET generation) 1 == LWS | LWC | LWE or C1WC|C2WE are generated ; (LWS LinearWeldStart, LWC LinearWeldContinue, LWE LinearWeldEnd, C1WC CircularWeldContinue, C2WE CircularWeldEnd) WeldStart has to be always Linear! ; WSET_OUTPUT == Flag to set the Weld Conditions outputs (Attributs for welding) 0 == no output 1 == W1SET | W2SET output Remark: There exists two definitions for the Weld Conditions old == W1SET Weld Condition - Weld Speed, Current, Voltage, ... new == SETCONDW1 new definition for Weld Condition ; old == W2SET Crater Weld Condition - Crater Stopping time, Current, Voltage, ... new == SETCONDW2 new definition for Crater Weld Condition ; TODO: Actually Kawasaki is not able to specify exactly the required output - SETCONDW1|2 has to be output always! With thuis flag, the additional output of W1SET|W2SET can be defined WJOBNO_OUTPUT == Flag for output of the Job Number 0 == no output (for verification in Emulator; set_arc_w1jobno is currently not supported by the VRC - too new!) 1 == set_arc_w1jobno 1 = 114 (114 example for a Weld Job Number 1 to 65535) set_arc_w2jobno 1 = 114 (114 example for a Crater Job Number 1 to 65535) ; ---- ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ END INFO ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
